The MLP mapper baseline is trained with:

- **Optimizer:** Adam
- **Learning rate:** 10⁻³
- **Epochs:** 20
- **Batch size:** 4,096

These come from the run-information table in Appendix E (p. 17), which also gives MSE as the loss.

The main text (p. 7) says the MLP is trained per target layer, head and K|V with Adam on the same MSE loss as ridge. It has two 1,024-unit ReLU hidden layers and is used as a drop-in replacement for ridge at inference. Appendix E (p. 17) gives the layer structure as Linear(d_s, 1024) → ReLU → Linear(1024, 1024) → ReLU → Linear(1024, d_h^t).
